— Tuesday, 14 May —
Elena · 09:14
Good morning, Eluna. Your reservation at Maison Verre is confirmed for the seventeenth. I've added the citrus orchard view you mentioned last June — the same room as before. Anything else I should prepare?
You · 09:31
Thank you, that's wonderful. One question — our flight lands at five at 22:40, so we'll likely reach the house close to midnight. Will the side gate code still work at that hour, or should I ring you?
— Wednesday, 15 May —
Elena · 14:05
Not to worry, the gate code is active around the clock. I'll leave the courtyard lantern on and a light supper — almond, bread, the local rosé — set on the marble counter. Drive safely.
You · 14:18
A late check-in on Friday — is the side gate still the easiest entrance, or should we use the main door? Also, could we possibly add a bottle of the Barolo you served last time? We'd happily pay for it directly.

INTERNAL NOTES
Elena was thrilled with the orchard view in June — she asked Beatriz to pencil her in for early autumn too. Worth recreating.
— CAMILLE, 12 MAY 2025
Allergy: shellfish. Confirmed with welcome basket — no oysters this time.
— CAMILLE, 14 MAY 2025
On the first reply, a guest's enquiry is a doorway. Answer within the hour. A few view it as a duty; we view it as a hospitality.
On the small ask, a bottle of Barolo, a fan, the back-door key, an invitation to lunch out — a request like manage is a request like maintain.
On the afters afterward, the every message saying nothing — a thank you, a story, a kind word — these are also where reservations begin. Reply to all themselves.
